literal_meaning: চোখে পড়া বা দৃষ্টি আকর্ষণ করা
figurative_meaning_en: To be pleasing or to one's liking
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই নতুন ড্রেসটি আমার নজরে ধরেছে।
তার গান শুনে সবার নজরে ধরে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: This new dress has caught my eye.
His song has pleased everyone and caught their attention.
note: This idiom is commonly used in modern Bengali to express immediate attraction or approval.
